description: Calculates when a tenant in Québec must receive the notice of rent increase or lease modification (art. 1942 C.C.Q.), whether that window is open today, and, if a receipt date is given, the date by which the tenant must reply (art. 1945 C.C.Q.). Works for fixed-term leases of 12 months or more, shorter leases, indeterminate leases and rooms.

change_date.description: Indeterminate lease: date the change (new rent) should take effect, YYYY-MM-DD.

lang.description: Language of the answer: fr (French) or en (English). Default: fr.

lease_end.description: Fixed lease: last day of the lease, YYYY-MM-DD (for example 2027-06-30).

lease_start.description: Fixed lease: first day of the current lease, YYYY-MM-DD. Used to tell a lease of 12 months or more from a shorter one. If missing, 12 months or more is assumed.

lease_type.description: fixed: the lease has an end date. indeterminate: the lease has no end date.

receipt_date.description: Optional: date the tenant received, or will receive, the notice, YYYY-MM-DD. Gives the reply deadline.

room.description: True if the tenant rents a room (much shorter deadlines: 10 to 20 days).

name: notice_deadlines
title: Québec lease notice deadlines
